bonding_required.quote: Prior to the issuance of a license, as a livestock dealer, each applicant therefor shall file a surety bond with the Department

definition_quote.value: "Livestock dealer" means any person required to be registered under the Federal "Packers and Stockyards Act, 1921", who buys, sells or offers to sell, exchange, barter, or negotiate the sale of cattle, goats, sheep, or swine other than feeder swine in this State whether the cattle, goats, sheep, or swine were raised in this State or brought into this State from another state.

bond_minimum_amount_dollars.quote: the amount of the bond shall not be less than $6,000

value: cash or securities deposited in escrow with a bank, savings and loan association or trust company

bond_alternative_forms.quote: In lieu of filing such bond, the livestock dealer may deliver to the Department the receipt of a duly authorized bank, savings and loan association or trust company in this State showing the deposit with the bank, savings and loan association or trust company of cash or of securities endorsed in blank by the owner thereof

federal_bond_accepted_in_lieu.quote: In cases where a livestock dealer under this Act has a bond on file with the United States Department of Agriculture, Packers and Stockyards, Agricultural Marketing Service, or any successor agency, and such bond is in an amount and conditioned upon such terms so as to meet the requirements of this Act, separate bond coverage under this Act is not required.

bond_covers_agent_transactions.quote: The surety bond, trust fund agreement or letter of credit filed by the licensee with the Department shall cover all livestock dealer transactions of the agent.

insolvency_trust_fund_procedure.quote: determination by a Department audit that the licensee or applicant is insolvent

agent_license_required.quote: A licensed livestock dealer may upon written request to the Department and upon paying the required fee, obtain an agent's permit for any person whom the dealer wishes to represent him.

dealer_liable_for_agent_acts.quote: the dealer shall be responsible for all livestock transactions conducted by his agent

agent_prohibited_from_own_account_transa.quote: An agent may not conduct transactions in his own behalf unless he is licensed as a livestock dealer.

value: person who sells only cattle, goats, sheep, or swine which he has produced and raised

person who offers for sale or trade only cattle, goats, sheep, or swine which he has owned or had in possession for 30 days or longer and is not engaged in the business of buying, selling, trading, or negotiating livestock

exemptions_from_licensure.quote: "Livestock dealer" does not mean (1) a person who sells only cattle, goats, sheep, or swine which he has produced and raised, (2) a person who offers for sale or trade only cattle, goats, sheep, or swine other than feeder swine which he has owned or had in his possession for a period of 30 days or longer and is not engaged in the business of buying, selling, trading, or negotiating the transfer of livestock

species_covered.quote: "Livestock" means cattle, goats, sheep, swine other than feeder swine, or any other animals of the bovine, caprine, ovine, or porcine species.

poultry_included_in_livestock_definition.quote: "Livestock" means cattle, goats, sheep, swine other than feeder swine, or any other animals of the bovine, caprine, ovine, or porcine species.

disease_testing_authority.quote: All persons licensed under this Act must also comply with all the provisions of the "Illinois Bovine Brucellosis Eradication Act" and the rules adopted pursuant to that law, the "Illinois Bovidae and Cervidae Tuberculosis Eradication Act"

quarantine_compliance_required.quote: All persons licensed under this Act must also comply with all the provisions of the "Illinois Diseased Animals Act" and the rules adopted pursuant to that law

livestock_auction_market_exemption_or_ov.quote: a person licensed under "An Act in relation to the licensing and regulation of livestock auction markets", approved July 15, 1941, as heretofore or hereafter amended, when engaged in transactions covered by such Act
